newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds track Bonos, end firmer.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds track Bonos, end firmer.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended another apathetic session slightly higher after tracking Spanish government bonds in the absence of foreign events to drive the market, dealers said.
"Short and medium term bonds should stay well-supported tomorrow," said one fixed rate director. "Longer bonds will depend on Spain and the auction of 10-year fixed rate bonds."
The money market ended calm with liquidity tight at the short end, dealers said. Overnight and tomorrow/next stood at 7.10/7.25 percent, compared with 7.00/7.10 percent in the morning.
